newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's Enap, Evergreen ink oil deal.
newsitem.headline: Chile's Enap, Evergreen ink oil deal.

text.p: State oil company Empresa Nacional del Petroleo SA, (Enap), and Evergreen Resources Inc have signed a 35-year agreement for oil and natural gas exploration in northern Chile, a government decree said.

The decree, dated October 25, 1996 but not published until Tuesday, sets terms and regulations for exploration and possibly eventual extraction of hydrocarbons in the Pampa de Tamarugal region in Chile's arid First Region.

The contract lasts for 35 years, with no more than the first 10 years for exploration followed by the production phase, which begins when Evergreen decides the deposit is commercially exploitable and starts sinking wells, said the decree.
